changes.impact: Q1 trading remained active. H1 and 9M large-project wins show buyers still choose FPT for complex technology work.
9M international IT margin of 15.32% corroborates commercial viability. Mix and labor constrain relative pricing claims.
Large-award counts show commercial traction. They cannot establish realized profitability or repeat-buying rates by themselves.
Consolidation boundary changed capital reporting. The customer contract/delivery assessment does not depend on group funded capital.
Leverage remains separate financial context. No retained evidence connects the reported change to loss of delivery capacity or customer access.
Telecom composition changed. The supported band rests on observed technology-services behavior.
Equity accounting for FTEL changes scope and financial ratios. Technology service buying and delivery are corroborated by eligible post-transition awards.
FTEL change is documented; no further loss of the specific technology mechanism was established in the reviewed event set.
Exclude scope-mixed group margins and return comparisons from moat proof.
The observed customer mechanism uses no WACC or ROIC inference.
AI may erode delivery/pricing advantages; AI and SBI developments provide no measured margin or retention benefit. 9M competitive wins support the existing limited differentiation band.

materialDependencies.impact: 14.74–16.33% is six months on selected operating lines. The annualized or full-scope spread is unbounded. FY25 gross funded sensitivity cleared the 15% hurdle by only 0.22 percentage points.
Six identified opening operating capital adjustments total VND −6.652tn. Opening working capital, eliminations and classifications remain unbounded. The residual could change the applicable spread.

FTEL was previously consolidated line by line. FPT retained 45.66% and recognizes its share through the equity method. Restated 9M sales growth and positive EBIT do not bound how recurring FTEL economics affected the old band.

From 1 January 2026 current operating results and balance sheet exclude line consolidation of FTEL. Issuer-restated P&L evidence has no consistent full opening capital bridge. Scope effects matter to the band.
